description: Existing eight-seed mix3 SiLU ensemble + ctx_mix3, mixed Gaussian/VP targets, 4372 configurations, z_s .2-12. Train-only; validation checkpoint selection. No final train+validation fit.
limitations: Line2 low-z N10 errors reach about5% at epsilon=.005 against Gaussian refs; worst-point VP comparison about4.2%.
z_s<.5 depends on r200 halo-edge choice; sparse corner validation errors remain.
Original guard and tail behavior preserved; no hardening or derivative-loss experimental models promoted.
New model scored on validation/regression references; no new test scoring.
Shipped model uses SiLU conditioners without a derivative-loss term; see planned_updates.
planned_updates: Derivative-loss (first-derivative penalty) training is planned: the shipped mix3-v1 weights do NOT include it; a derivative-loss retrain will be published as a later FLUMEN update.
